title: Reproducible BOLD findings in ReadyNeuro
abstract: Which patterns in human BOLD fMRI recur across independent ReadyNeuro studies, and which apparent patterns come from acquisition, preprocessing or shared source scans? In one held-out source family, reused scans showed 99.917% less cortical lag-one disagreement than different-source pairs from the same protocol. The frequency of scan reuse across ReadyNeuro remains unknown. The charter maps supported findings, unresolved studies and proposed tests.
